title: Impossible to monitor and remove unauthorised court recordings from YouTube: Google to Delhi High Court
description: American tech giant Google has told the Delhi High Court that it is impossible for it to proactively monitor and act against unauthorised recording of online court proceedings and uploading/ sharing of such recordings to its video platform YouTube. In its affidavit before the Court, Google said that directing social media platforms to prevent the recurrence and re-upload of unauthorised recordings of court proceedings is legally untenable and impossible to implement.
